articles.title: Apple Unveils Its First Ever Foldable Phone — The iPhone Duo
articles.summary: Apple has revealed a brand-new type of iPhone called the iPhone Duo. Unlike regular phones, the iPhone Duo can fold in half like a small book, making it easier to carry in a pocket. This is the first time Apple has ever made a foldable phone, even though other companies like Samsung have been making them for years. Apple says the phone has a stronger screen that will not crack when folded many times. Technology fans around the world are excited, but the new device is expected to cost significantly more than a standard iPhone. It will go on sale in selected countries later this year.

lv1: What is the name of Apple's new foldable phone? (蘋果公司新款摺疊手機叫什麼名字？)
How is the iPhone Duo different from a regular phone? (iPhone Duo 與普通手機有什麼分別？)
lv2: Why do you think Apple waited so long before making a foldable phone, even though other companies already had them? (你認為蘋果公司為什麼要等這麼久才製造摺疊手機，即使其他公司早已推出？)
What might be the advantages and disadvantages of a phone that folds in half? (一部可以對折的手機有什麼優點和缺點？)
lv3: Some people argue that companies like Apple release new products mainly to make money, not because the products truly improve our lives. Do you agree or disagree, and why? (有人認為蘋果等公司推出新產品主要是為了賺錢，而非真正改善我們的生活。你同意嗎？為什麼？)
As phones become more expensive and more advanced, what responsibility do technology companies have towards people who cannot afford to buy the latest devices? (當手機越來越昂貴、越來越先進，科技公司對負擔不起最新設備的人有什麼責任？)

articles.title: Global Ocean Protection Treaty Now in Full Effect, Covering Areas Beyond Any Country's Control
articles.summary: A historic international agreement designed to protect ocean life in the parts of the sea that belong to no single country has officially come into force this year. Known as the High Seas Treaty, this agreement was made under the United Nations and requires countries to work together to protect marine animals, plants, and habitats far out at sea. More than half of the world's ocean surface is covered by these international waters. Scientists and environmental groups have called it one of the most important steps for ocean conservation in decades. Countries that signed the treaty must now follow rules to limit overfishing and pollution in these distant waters.

lv1: What is the High Seas Treaty trying to protect? (《公海條約》旨在保護什麼？)
Who made the High Seas Treaty? (《公海條約》是由誰制定的？)
lv2: Why is it more difficult to protect the high seas compared to waters near a country's coastline? (為什麼保護公海比保護靠近海岸的水域更加困難？)
How might overfishing in international waters affect people who live far from the ocean? (公海過度捕魚會如何影響遠離海洋居住的人？)
lv3: Some fishing industries argue that the High Seas Treaty will harm their businesses and the livelihoods of fishing communities. How should the world balance environmental protection with people's economic needs? (部分捕魚業認為《公海條約》會損害其生意及漁業社區的生計。世界應如何在環境保護與人們的經濟需求之間取得平衡？)

If a country refuses to follow the rules of the High Seas Treaty, what do you think should happen? Is it fair for international rules to override a country's own choices? (如果一個國家拒絕遵守《公海條約》的規則，你認為應該怎麼辦？國際規則凌駕於國家自身選擇之上，公平嗎？)

articles.title: Meta AI正式登港　本地用戶可用獨立應用程式體驗人工智能
articles.summary: Meta公司於9月11日宣布，旗下人工智能助理服務Meta AI已正式進入香港市場，本地用戶即日起可透過專屬應用程式使用這項服務。Meta AI能夠回答問題、協助寫作及進行對話，功能與其他人工智能助理相似。隨著人工智能服務在香港普及，社會各界對其在教育、工作及日常生活上的影響愈來愈關注。有教育工作者認為，學生應學習如何善用這類工具，同時要培養獨立思考能力，避免過度依賴科技。

lv1: Meta AI是哪間公司推出的服務？
Meta AI何時正式在香港推出？
lv2: Meta AI在香港推出，對學生的學習生活可能帶來哪些改變？
為什麼有教育工作者擔心學生過度依賴人工智能工具？
lv3: 人工智能助理可以幫助人們完成很多工作，但有人擔心這會令人們失去獨立思考的能力。你認為學校應如何制定使用人工智能的規則？
如果人工智能變得愈來愈聰明，未來有些職業可能會消失。你認為社會應如何幫助受影響的人？

articles.title: 堅彌地城海旁海堤擬列二級歷史建築　盼結合科技展示舊碼頭故事
articles.summary: 位於香港堅彌地城海旁的一段舊海堤，正被建議評定為二級歷史建築，以保護這段具有歷史價值的海濱設施。有關官員表示，希望日後能夠在該地點引入科技元素，讓市民和遊客透過互動展示，了解昔日碼頭的歷史面貌。這項建議反映香港社會對保育文化遺產的重視，同時亦展示出以創新科技講述城市歷史故事的新方向。若獲正式評級，海堤將受到法定保護，不得隨意拆卸或改建。

lv1: 堅彌地城的舊海堤被建議評為哪個級別的歷史建築？
官員希望在海堤加入什麼元素，讓人們了解其歷史？
lv2: 為什麼保護歷史建築對香港的文化和社會有重要意義？
利用科技展示歷史，比起傳統展示方法有什麼優點和缺點？
lv3: 有人認為舊建築應該拆除，騰出空間建設新設施，滿足現代城市發展需要；也有人認為應盡力保育歷史遺跡。你支持哪種看法？為什麼？
如果你是城市規劃者，你會如何在發展與保育之間作出平衡，同時兼顧不同市民的需要？
